about: The model settings elm-pi ships, each with the evidence it was chosen on. tests/test_tuning_evidence.py checks the templates still ship these.

decisions.why: The gateway samples Mistral at 1.0 when nothing is sent; Mistral says 0.0-0.7 with reasoning off. 38/51 against 33/51. Swept with reasoning off: 60, 62, 59, 60 of 75 at 0, 0.15, 0.4, 0.7 - level.

Mistral's figure for reasoning_effort high; 46/51 with reasoning on. Re-tested in the tuning run: 72/75 at 0.7, 73 at 0.15, 69 at 0.4. top_p tested 2026-11-12: 0.8 +6.0 points against both shipped controls (95% task interval -0.4 to +12.8, Holm p 0.26), 0.95 +3.8: not shown; 0.8 tested again on its own, under a rule written beforehand: +1.4 points over 443 pairs, p 0.63, interval -2.7 to +5.1 - not shipped.
Reasoning on: 46/51 and no run failed without a tool call, against 35/51 with it off.

Qwen's instruct profile: 41/42, against 39 without the presence penalty and 40 with the thinking profile. Temperature swept: 72/75 at 0.2, 0.4 and 0.7, 69 at 1.0. Re-tested 2026-11-12 on 50 tasks, pair by pair against the shipped profile: top_p 0.95 -0.8 points, top_k 40 -0.7, min_p 0.05 +1.4, presence_penalty 0 +1.5 and 0.5 -0.7, its own repeat -0.8; none p below 0.5. repetition_penalty 1.0 added 2026-11-17: the card's value for both modes, sent rather than left to the server (the gateway validates and applies it; the model's generation_config.json carries no penalty), not yet measured against other values.
Qwen's thinking profile, from the model card; thinking stays off (measured ~400x slower), so not re-measured. repetition_penalty 1.0 added 2026-11-17, the card's value.
Accepted by the gateway, but no setting was measured with the fields; keeps PI_CACHE_RETENTION=long from adding them.

The temperature Llama's tool requests reach ELM at. 0.3 scored 41/75 and 0.6 37 in the sweep; four runs at 0 scored 41, 35, 36 and 33, so neither is shown better. Again 2026-11-12, 50 tasks, pair by pair: 0.3 -0.8 points, 0.6 +2.3, the repeat of 0 +4.5.

How long a request may send nothing - no headers, no token - before pi ends it and retries. Over 41,261 successful ELM requests (tuning runs under 429 storms included), the longest wait before a short reply began was 58.4s, and none passed 60s; the two streams that did stall ran 477.6s and 1126.6s under pi's 300s default, one of them test6's eight minutes. 120s is twice the longest healthy wait, and ends a dead stream 180s sooner.
